```sql
SELECT CAST(num_count AS DOUBLE) / den_count AS accepted_rate
FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_count
    FROM main."posts" q
    WHERE q."PostTypeId" = 1
      AND q."AcceptedAnswerId" IS NOT NULL
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM main."posts" a
          WHERE a."Id" = q."AcceptedAnswerId"
            AND a."CreaionDate" >= '2013-12-01'
            AND a."CreaionDate" < '2014-01-01'
      )
      AND q."CreaionDate" >= '2013-12-01'
      AND q."CreaionDate" < '2014-01-01'
) n,
(
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS den_count
    FROM main."posts"
    WHERE "PostTypeId" = 1
      AND "CreaionDate" >= '2013-12-01'
      AND "CreaionDate" < '2014-01-01'
) d;
```
